description:
Make a named folder on one tab to file hooks or finds in. The same name again on
    that tab (case and spaces aside) returns the folder already there with created false,
    so a retry never makes two. At most 200 folders an account (409
    folder_limit_reached). Returns the folder: folder_id, kind, name, item_count, cover,
    shared, share_url, created. Same as POST /v1/folders. Free. Next: save_to_folder.

kind.description: the tab: "short" (Short form hooks), "long" (Long form finds) or "packaging" (Packaging finds)
kind.title: Kind

name.description: 1 to 80 characters; the same name again on the tab is the folder already there
name.title: Name

team.description: true: your team's folder, which every member sees and edits (404 not_in_team without a team)
team.title: Team

name: create_folder
